scientific_integrity: The infinite theorem has a symbolic combinatorial proof. Finite enumerations and sampled parameter checks corroborate but do not replace that proof. Historical priority is qualified; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite generalized quadrangles with both order parameters \(s,t\ge2\); non-counting first-order logic in at most three variables in the enriched distance signature. Width-four separation is in that signature only; thin geometries and counting logic are not treated.
title: Three-variable metric collapse of finite thick generalized-quadrangle incidence graphs
